scope.counting: Each source-tree node is audited separately; repeated physical positions and transpositions are not independent joseki. Effective forks skip non-move SGF nodes and preserve different setup diagrams.
scope.sourceOrder: Numeric OGS variation_label is an initial preference guide under equal outside conditions, often reflecting what is commonly played. It is not a win rate, margin, or unconditional ranking; ties remain ties.
scope.quality: Source quality labels can distinguish good/mistake/conditional, but equal labels do not rank alternatives. One surviving non-bad move is only the sole recorded continuation, not a proof of optimality.
scope.reviewedPosition: A review matches the full board and side to play under symmetry/color reversal, as in the explorer; it does not prove whole-board applicability or resolve ladders.
scope.behavior: This is a data audit; browser tests separately verify that automatic continuation stops at unselected branches.
